parse_frame_range_from_string: parse a comma-separated frame range string like 1-10,15,21-40 into a NamedOptionalSet
create_FrameRange_with_num_frames: create a FrameRange object from an OptionalSet clipped to a total number of frames
compute_FrameRange_intersection: compute the intersection of a FrameRange with another OptionalSet to narrow selected frames
get_sorted_frames_from_FrameRange: get a sorted list of all frame indices from a FrameRange using the frames method
create_OptionalSet_intersection: create an OptionalSet and compute its intersection with another OptionalSet for frame filtering
